question: In the experimental matrix of sewage sludge co-incineration in a fluidized bed, which runs vary the bed particle size, and to what sizes?
expect: runs 6 and 7: 545 um and 775 um (all other runs 650 um) (Table 2)
rendered:
Document: Co-Incineration of Real Municipal Sewage Sludge in a Fluidized Bed: Effects of the Coexistence of P, Fe, and Na on Agglomeration and Heavy Metal Emissions

Page 2: The incineration feedstock was composed of a dried sludge matrix mixed with wood chips and polypropylene (PP) pellets, which were packaged in polyethylene (PE) bags with a total weight of 2.45 g.
Experimental variables included the incineration temperature, gas velocity, bed particle size, and P, Na, and Fe ratios, as detailed in the experimental matrix in Table 2.
